_help: The 'Links I Like' page. One entry per site. id: short, lowercase, letters/numbers/dashes, never change it once people have voted (clicks and votes are stored under it). founded: free text, e.g. "2008" or "April 10, 2008". rank: your personal ranking, 1 = favourite. color: the site's main colour as a hex code; the card is tinted with it. image: optional picture (a path on this site such as /assets/links/github.webp, or an https address). video: optional short clip (mp4/webm path); it plays muted on hover. Leave image and video blank and the card draws a coloured tile with the site's first letter.
